categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC method implementation in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a silent correctness bug where scanblocks ignores LookupFilterRange errors and returns incomplete match results as successful. As noted in the description, 'The result is a silent gap: a caller gets a relevant_blocks list that looks fine but is missing any match in the unindexed range', creating fund-safety and correctness risks for applications relying on filter scanning.
